purpose: Teach: 道中/抜け出し/母校/ためし/ところどころ/道理/平然と/此処

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お出かけの道中はお父さんと仲良くね
lines.en: Sho, be kind to your father while you're out, all right?
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring opener. Soft breath before the name. Warm and practical — the kind of reminder a mother gives not out of doubt but out of care for both of them. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんとお家を抜け出しちゃった
lines.en: Mom… Grandpa and I kind of snuck out of the house.
lines.style: Quiet confession. A small, careful voice — testing whether she'll be upset. Eyes down at first. Slight pause before the admission, like he's been holding it. Not defiant, just truthful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんの母校はあの学校だったのよ
lines.en: Sho, that school there — that's where I went when I was your age.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. A moment of distance in her voice — she's seeing something from her own past. Gentle on the name. Warm but slightly distant, like sharing a quiet memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ためしにピアノ弾いたらいい音がしたよ
lines.en: Mom… I tried playing the piano and it sounded really nice.
lines.style: Wonder and small pride in his voice. Quiet delight — not boasting, but genuinely surprised at what he discovered. Soft lightness on the memory. Seeking her approval gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家のお花、ところどころ咲いてるわね
lines.en: Sho, the flowers in the garden are starting to bloom in little patches.
lines.style: Observant and wistful. She's noticing something small and lovely. Soft, almost to herself — the voice of someone who sees these details and holds them. Calm and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが道理を教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom… Grandpa taught me something about how things work.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. He's learned something real and he's trying to hold it carefully in his words. Respectful mention of his grandfather. Slight wonder underneath — he's processing something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは平然とお仕事へお出かけになるわね
lines.en: Sho, your father just heads off to work like it's nothing, doesn't he?
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly distant. She's observing something about him — maybe admiring, maybe a little puzzled. Soft tone. Not critical, but noticing. A quiet moment of seeing someone she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、此処にぼくの絵を貼ってもいい?
lines.en: Mom… can I put my drawing up here?
lines.style: Hopeful, seeking permission gently. His voice lifts slightly with the question. Looking at the space, then back to her. Simple want — just wanting his work to be seen and kept.
